theorem.alternative_mass: The exact common alternative mass is (2[S_n:<C>]/n!)^k.
theorem.coherent_deflation: S_n QFT flags the per-register trivial sector for <C>=S_n and the trivial-plus-sign sectors for <C>=A_n.
theorem.common_dimension: The common dimension is [S_n:<C>]^k, hence 1 or 2^k.
theorem.common_intersection: intersection_h ran(P_h)=C[S_n/<C>]^tensor k because every right involution acts trivially on every register.
theorem.outlier_eigenvalue: sum_h P_h equals M times identity on the common intersection, so the synthesis singular value is sqrt(M).
theorem.scope_limit: Removing the common block does not bound the remaining operator norm; pairwise/higher intersections and polar label erasure remain open.
theorem.symmetric_group_normal_closure: For even n>=6, the fixed-point-free class normally generates S_n when n/2 is odd and A_n when n/2 is even.
theorem.variance_share: Its share of the centered synthesis variance is ((M-1)/M)(4[S_n:<C>]/n!)^k.

theorem_contract.deflation_primitive: Coherent per-register S_n Fourier tests for trivial, or trivial-plus-sign, right-invariant sectors.
theorem_contract.family: Fixed-point-free involutions in S_n, every even n>=6.
theorem_contract.outlier: The exact intersection of every candidate range, not an empirically selected high-eigenvalue sector.
theorem_contract.outside_scope: The spectrum on the orthogonal complement and recursive pairwise/higher-intersection deflation.
